svg.title: Counterexamples define the boundary of the findings
svg.desc: Seven retained counterexamples and countervailing records directly limit broad claims. They are included as analytical evidence, not as decorative caveats, and do not represent a prevalence estimate.

g.text: Counterexamples define the boundary of the findings

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Seven retained records directly challenge or narrow broad interpretations
Unit: reviewed counterexample record • n = 7 retained • Evidence: one direct quantitative; six qualitative or mechanism-bounding
Every record materially bounds a claim; unresolved conflicts are tracked separately.
